style.prompt: Painterly digital animation in pearl-grey, faded blue and muted amber, with brushed textures and soft, diffuse dawn light.. Character reference of @keeper: Human woman, 1.68 metres tall, approximately sixty years old, with narrow shoulders, weathered hands, a lined face and grey hair tied back; wearing a heavy charcoal coat, dark trousers and practical boots.. Full body, front view, neutral pose, plain light grey background.

request: A short film, 2 minutes. A lighthouse keeper finds a glowing shell on the beach at dawn. She brings it home. At night it hums and the lamp goes out. She climbs the tower in a storm and uses the shell to relight it. Ships are saved. Morning again, she puts the shell back on the beach. Melancholy, painterly, no dialogue, just score.
